title: Low-Rank Decomposition and Flow-Based Invariants for #BIS on Bipartite Graphs: The Chronos-Architecture
topic: The C-3PO Framework: Algorithms for #BIS-Hard Problems on Graphs with Low Threshold Rank
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints
description: The Chronos-Architecture addresses the counting of independent sets (#BIS) on bipartite graphs whose left-side adjacency matrix exhibits low threshold rank....
abstract: The Chronos-Architecture addresses the counting of independent sets (\#BIS) on bipartite graphs whose left-side adjacency matrix exhibits low threshold rank. By decomposing the graph into a low-rank core and a sparse remainder, the framework applies a Gaussian-elimination routine over GF(2) to compute the rank exactly, then enumerates independent sets within the core using a depth-first search that respects the invariant that the rank remains unchanged under edge additions that preserve bipartiteness. Theoretical analysis shows that the overall algorithm runs in $O(|V|+|E|)$ time for rank-preserving updates and $O(2^{r})$ for enumeration, where $r$ is the rank. The implementation is fully in Chronos-Interpreter and has been verified by static AST inspection and formal invariant proofs. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Chronos-Interpreter-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261102_050124_the_c-3po_framework__algorithm}
